## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Milan, Italy. It starts at Via Vittorio Veneto 52.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Step inside Leolandia and be the first in this special park for kids and babies! Visit eight themed areas and enjoy themed entertainment, an educational animal farm, and more than 50 attractions for kids. Leolandia is the most popular theme park in Italy for a very good reason!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €41.14. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 368 ratings and 157 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
